n2f1f33656a.headline: GCC to lose $270 billion in oil revenues in 2020, says IMF
n2f1f33656a.summary: The IMF forecasts that Gulf Cooperation Council countries will lose $270 billion in oil revenues in 2020, with Saudi Arabia expected to contract further while the UAE reopens its economy quickly.
n2f1f33656a.why: Oil revenues are critical to GCC economies; large revenue losses impact fiscal budgets, economic growth, and regional financial markets.

n6c3480513b.headline: Nigeria’s unclaimed dividends hit N158.44bn in 2019
n6c3480513b.summary: Unclaimed dividends in the Nigerian capital market totaled N158.44 billion as of December 2019.
n6c3480513b.why: Large unclaimed dividends indicate potential inefficiencies in shareholder payments and liquidity in Nigeria's capital markets.

n39b000872d.headline: Wizz Air resumes flights from Ukraine to the UAE: details
n39b000872d.summary: Hungarian low-cost carrier Wizz Air plans to restart direct flights from Odessa, Ukraine, to Abu Dhabi, UAE, beginning October 1.
n39b000872d.why: Resumption of international flights supports economic recovery in travel and tourism sectors amid easing pandemic restrictions.
